title: Water's Echo

outfit_card.silhouette: Layered A-line gown with a fitted corset bodice, cascading sheer overskirt, asymmetrical draped tulle train, and slim detachable sleeves.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: A woven crown of ivory blossoms and delicate vines, with trailing sheer ribbons and a gossamer veil cascading from the back.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Chiffon bodice with a sweetheart neckline, draped pearl chains and tiny gold-leaf embroidery, paired with airy detached sheer sleeves and a vine-wrapped armlet.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Tiered organza skirt with leaf-shaped appliqués and a flowing asymmetric tulle train, revealing strappy gold-trimmed sandals with floral ankle ties.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: A small bird companion perched on the shoulder, floating water-lily motifs, and a translucent veil that mimics rippling water.
